title: Piano and harmony study for clarinetists
summary: Simeon never studied harmony or piano much, advises spending time on one's own instrument, though piano helps with chords.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: Did you ever study any of the harmony? Did you ever play any on piano, try to pick out chords?
You never had any lessons on that?
I used to just, you know, one finger, strike three, three notes. Chords.
But I never did play piano much.
You think it's a good idea for clarinetists to learn it, or would you advise them to stick, spend the time they have on their own instrument?
Well, spend most of the time on my own particular instrument. Sometimes I go to the piano, figure out a chord, you know.
Would it be a good idea for clarinetists to learn a little bit about piano too, if they have time?
Well, it depends how far you want to go in music.
It's really necessary though, to be a good musician on the clarinetist.
